summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is string-obfuscated (`_0xNNNN` identifiers), downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})` to run a sibling file at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled script (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, hex-name identifiers) whose behavior cannot be inspected without execution. The payload is not referenced from the library's main entry (`dist/cjs/index.cjs`) and its filename (`math_init.js`) has no relationship to the package's advertised files-sync purpose. Fetching Bun from its official domain is itself an aggressive-but-legitimate practice, but here it is used to execute an opaque, obfuscated, bundled blob at preinstall — an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
